label: Rotating triangle, rooted pair and uncovered edge controls, checked
meaning: Controls for J2 and its rival. The rotating triangle shows that well-founded support at every world together with the negation of the mutual-support rival yields neither J2 nor the join's endpoint: a three-step cross-world cycle survives. The rooted pair shows that the mutual-support rival is compatible with the join's endpoint, every other premise of NecessaryConcreteUnderived.checks and coverage, so J2, the no-novel-edge condition and same-supporter presence are each stronger than the endpoint needs. The uncovered edge shows that J1 and J2 with the other premises imply neither coverage nor the no-novel-edge condition. Model-witnessed only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible. Excluded middle is supplied by Lean's classical axioms.
